about.description: Single-stock perpetual on edgeX (Amber Group-incubated) tracking Broadcom Inc. (AVGO), with pricing referencing Stork decentralized oracle network (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to Broadcom Inc. share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on StarkEx (migrating to EDGE Chain L2).
